Analyze Git commits and link them to work items (backlog items, milestones,
goals).

This command analyzes Git commits to:
  - Extract work item references from commit messages (BLI-*, MIL-*, GOAL-*)
  - Create code_reference objects for changed files
  - Link commits to work items
  - Enable queries like "What code changes support goal X?"

Usage:
  zqk system git [command]

Available Commands:
  analyze     Analyze Git commits and link to work items
  query       Query code changes for a work item

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system git [command] --help" for more information about a command.
